name: product-builder-lecture
description: QR party rock-paper-scissors game for web and mobile app stores

scripts.cap:init: npm run build:web && npx cap init "마루의 가위바위보" com.maru.rps --web-dir dist
scripts.cap:add:ios: npm run build:web && npx cap add ios
scripts.cap:add:android: npm run build:web && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync
scripts.test:syntax: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const html=fs.readFileSync('index.html','utf8'); const m=html.match(/<script>([\s\S]*)<\/script>/); new Function(m[1]); console.log('JS syntax OK')"
